name: Waldorf Astoria Hotel & Residences Miami
notes: Height conflict settled: 1,049 ft is stated by Florida YIMBY in February 2026 and again in August 2026, and is stored; a 1,041 ft figure circulated earlier and is superseded. The 1,255 ft in the November 2024 FAA filing is the requested crane height above ground, not the building, and is not stored. No unit count is published in the coverage read for this run.

values.developer: Property Markets Group; Greybrook Realty Partners; Mohari Hospitality; S2 Development; Hilton

name: Aria Reserve Miami — South Tower
notes: One of twin 62-storey towers rising 649 ft along Biscayne Bay; the two towers yield 782 condominiums combined, and no per-tower unit count is published, so units are not found for this row. The North Tower is recorded separately at 725 NE 24 St. Melo Group builds through its in-house contractor, Melo Contractors Corp, which is also the contractor on the City's permit.

name: Aria Reserve Miami — North Tower
notes: The second of the twin 62-storey Aria Reserve towers; the 782-condominium figure covers both towers, so no unit count is stored for this row. Melo Group is also serving as general contractor through its in-house construction arm.

name: Cipriani Residences Miami
notes: Height: the tower is reported as expected to reach approximately 950 ft on completion (April 2026), having reached 872 ft at that date; an approximately 940 ft figure was published in October 2025. The 950 ft completion figure is stored as the building height under the conflict rule and the measured 872 ft is noted here. Interiors by 1508 London; structural engineering by Thornton Tomasetti.

name: Baccarat Residences Miami
notes: Height is 848 ft above ground; the same filing gives 852 ft above sea level, which is not the figure stored. Expected completion early 2028.

name: The St. Regis Residences, Miami
notes: Storey count conflict: 50 storeys reported November 2024, 47 storeys and 632 ft in July 2025. The later figures are stored under the conflict rule.

name: Casa Bella Residences by B&B Italia
notes: Completed and opened in October 2026, which agrees with the certificate of occupancy on the City's permit record. Interiors by Piero Lissoni of Lissoni New York; landscape design by Enzo Enea.

name: 2600 Biscayne
notes: A 41-storey mixed-use tower of more than 900,000 sq ft with approximately 160,000 sq ft of Class A office space and 400 rental apartments. The reinforced concrete superstructure topped out in September 2025. KD Construction of Florida is the shell contractor.

name: The River District — Phase 1
notes: The first phase of The River District (also known as Miami River), a 4-million-sq-ft master-planned mixed-use development. Tekton Construction handled shell construction.

name: Residences in the Grove
notes: The 2023 coverage describes a five-storey, 148-unit building, which does not reconcile with the 448,000 sq ft and $165m on the City's building permit, so no storey count or height is stored from it. The $43.2m 2023 facility was a refinancing loan funding demolition and site work, not construction financing, so no lender is recorded.

name: Villa Miami
notes: Topped out October 2026. Developed with Major Food Group as partner; interiors by Vicky Charles of Charles & Co.

name: FIVESIXTY Waterfront Residences + Club
notes: A 38-storey luxury rental tower nearing completion. The September 2024 financing comprised $172m of senior construction financing from affiliates of Apollo Global Management plus $56m of preferred equity from Sixth Street; Apollo is recorded as the construction lender and Sixth Street is the preferred equity and so not recorded there.

name: Missoni Baia
notes: Asymptote Architecture is the design architect and Revuelta Architecture International the architect of record, so Revuelta is stored and Asymptote recorded here, per the field rule. Civic Construction served as construction manager and Desimone as structural engineer. The 700 Edgewater Development LLC partnership is OKO Group, Cain International and OB Group.

values.developer: OKO Group; Cain International; OB Group

name: 2900 Terrace
notes: Topped out August 2026, nearly three months ahead of schedule. The $210.5m construction financing secured in 2025 is reported without naming the lender, so lender is not found.

name: The Wynwood Plaza — office tower
notes: The 12-storey, 266,000 sq ft Class AAA office component of The Wynwood Plaza, a one-million-sq-ft mixed-use development. Shorenstein Properties is a project partner and Claure Group a co-investor. The coverage read for this run names no architect. Tekton Construction is the shell contractor.

values.developer: L&L Holding Company; Oak Row Equities

name: JEM Miami Worldcenter
notes: A 67-storey mixed-use residential tower of an estimated 741,252 sq ft, permitted under 175 Northeast 10th Street and occupying a full-block site. The condominium component, marketed as JEM Private Residences, begins on the 43rd floor with 273 units. The $465m construction financing secured in 2025 is reported without naming the lender.

name: Midtown 7
notes: Height is the FAA determination of 352 ft above ground; the same letter gives 367 ft above sea level, which is not the figure stored. The developer is PPF AMLI 3001 NE 1st Avenue, LLC, an affiliate of AMLI Residential.

name: Mohawk at Wynwood
notes: 12- and eight-storey residential towers around an open-air pedestrian paseo connecting Northeast 28th and 29th Streets. The January 2026 capital stack was $150m in total, led by $124.2m of C-PACE financing from Nuveen Green Capital with a $25m senior secured loan from ABANCA USA; both are recorded as construction lenders. Interiors by RADYCA.

name: Dulce Vida Apartments
notes: Named from the owner of record on the City's own building permit, DULCE VIDA APARTMENTS LLC. No acceptable source publishes a unit count, height, developer or architect for this project, so those are not found; the contractor, permitted area, cost and status come from the City's permit record.

name: The Rider Residences

name: The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, Miami — tower at 1 Island Drive
notes: Part of The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, Miami, a two-tower residential and hotel development Swire Properties broke ground on in October 2026, with completion scheduled for 2030. The coverage gives the site as 500 Brickell Key Drive and 750 Claughton Island Drive and describes a 66-storey South Tower of 850 ft and a 33-storey North Tower of 426 ft, but does not say which tower corresponds to the City's 1 Island Drive and which to 2 Island Drive. Storey count and height are therefore not stored on either row: assigning them would be a guess about which permit is which tower. Developer, architect and contractor are shared by both towers and so are safe to record.

name: The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, Miami — tower at 2 Island Drive
notes: Part of The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, Miami, a two-tower residential and hotel development Swire Properties broke ground on in October 2026, with completion scheduled for 2030. Storey count and height are therefore not stored on either row: assigning them would be a guess about which permit is which tower. Developer, architect and contractor are shared by both towers and so are safe to record. This row is the one the City records under Swire Brickell Key Hotel Ltd, so it is the tower carrying the hotel component.

name: Miami Freedom Park — stadium
notes: A component of Miami Freedom Park, a 131-acre development at 1802 NW 37th Avenue in Grapeland Heights on the former Melreese golf course, anchored by a 25,000-seat stadium. Miami Freedom Park, LLC is named as the developer and Arquitectonica as the architect for the master plan, with ArquitectonicaGEO as landscape architect; those are recorded on each of the three parcels the City permits separately. A later article covers the scheme's eight-storey administration building specifically, developed by Adler Development and built by Moss Construction -- the City's permit records do not say which parcel that building sits on, so that team is not attached to any one row. This row is the stadium parcel; the stadium seats 25,000.

name: LOFTY Brickell (One Brickell Riverfront)
notes: One of the two towers of One Brickell Riverfront, alongside the 45-storey, 422-residence Standard Residences, Brickell; both are designed by Arquitectonica. KD Construction of Florida is the shell contractor and the City's permit names GT Construction & Development as contractor. The development secured $513m of construction financing in late 2025 without the lender being named.

name: 830 Brickell
notes: A 57-storey Class A+ office tower, the first stand-alone Class A+ office building delivered in Brickell in more than a decade. Storey count published as 55 during construction in 2021 and 57 on completion, so the later figure is stored. Adrian Smith + Gordon Gill Architecture is named as designer with Revuelta Architecture International alongside; Adrian Smith + Gordon Gill is stored. The $630m Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan package of December 2025 is a refinancing, not construction financing, so no lender is recorded. The press dates completion to 2023 while the City's permit record carries a later certificate; the City record drives the stage.

name: Downtown 6
notes: Also written Downtown 6th. Melo Architecture is the design architect and G3aec the architect of record, so G3aec is stored and Melo Architecture noted here, per the field rule. Storey count rose through the filings -- 54 at Urban Development Review Board approval in 2023, 58 in April 2025, 60 on topping out in March 2026 -- and the latest is stored. The identification is firm: the 2023 article's 1,081,913 sq ft matches the City's permit figure exactly. The permit contractor, Melo Contractors Corp, is Melo Group's in-house construction arm.
